reasons: Claimed status is compliant, and the redline is identical to the original with no comment, which is the expected output for a compliant finding.

Cited text supports the preferred position: § 9.4 limits Customer's liability on convenience termination to Fees for conforming Services rendered plus refund of prepayments, § 27.3 allows force-majeure termination 'without penalty', and no stipulated-sum, penalty, or minimum termination fee payable by Customer appears in the supplied paragraphs.

The § 2.1 take-or-pay commitment is a minimum purchase obligation rather than a stipulated damages amount triggered by breach or termination; deferring it to the minimum-commitment rule is consistent with the instruction not to flag the same commercial term under two rules absent independent breach.
No actionable proposal is required, and none was made, so there is nothing directionally wrong or over-flagged here.
